bluf: Webranking is a Correggio based agency that calls itself Italy's largest digital agency, claiming €250M of advertising investment handled in 2025, €60M in revenue and 260 consultants. It sells an enterprise mix led by SEO, recast as Search Everywhere Optimization for LLMs, over paid search, paid social, programmatic and web build. The record points outward: a 2026-07 consolidated international model and a 2026-09 EMEA media appointment by Napapijri. The one thing a rival should know: it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt, runs no social ad pixel on its own site, its sitemap shows nothing updated in 12 months, and 21 of its 30 named clients are names only.
doing:
The positioning line reads: self described largest Italian digital agency, born digital, now integrating offline media, events and traditional channels across Build, Boost and Bridge service families. In plain words, a search and performance shop grown into a full service media agency. The headline claim is scale: €250M of advertising investment handled in 2025 with 260 consultants and €60M in revenue.

SEO leads the sold mix at score 3: its SEO page claims a leading SEO agency for complex projects. Seven lines score 2 at core: AI search, paid search, paid social, programmatic and CTV, web and product, data and measurement, and AI automation, breadth 14. The evidence notes name Adobe Analytics and a marketing mix model service, a Performance Marketing page running Search, Social and Marketplace in one framework, and the Crédit Agricole Italia headless build on the homepage. Proprietary items are the Build, Boost, Bridge model, Osservatori (in house market research) and Point of W, a navigation section not captured. The one named partner is LinkedIn, co host of the B2B Accelerate event in Milan in June 2026.

Its AI posture reframes SEO as Search Everywhere Optimization for LLMs, scales creative production with AI and sells martech, machine learning and generative AI under a Martech, Algorithmic & Generative AI line. No audited AI visibility product shows in the record: no tracking, scorecard or citation share.

Dated moves: 2024, Great Place To Work Europe Best Workplaces; 2026-06, a MediaStar award for creative direction; 2026-07, a consolidated international model pairing central governance with local expertise; 2026-09, Napapijri picked it as media agency for EMEA. The record holds no news items, no jobs and no ATS.

Pricing signals are absent: the record lists no pricing model. For a company claiming 260 consultants, it also lists no offices, no dates on its 43 case studies, and no test tool, ABM stack or social pixel on its own site.
clients:
The client type on record is enterprise across banking and insurance, fashion and luxury, food and beverage, retail, automotive and travel; the home market is Italy; the 2026-09 Napapijri appointment extends its media remit to EMEA.

The record names 30 clients: 9 observed and 21 names only. BPER Banca came for paid performance and brand (DOOH, audio and display reaching almost 18 million unique users). Crédit Agricole Italia came for web build (a headless architecture and a new site). Tod's is read as AI and automation (predictive AI on returns credited with an 81% revenue rise), Hogan (Gruppo TOD's) as commerce (FeedGen from Google lifting online sales up to 72% in Shopping campaigns). Subito came for data (tag management), Unipol Rental for brand (a new site for usability and identity), Miroglio for web build and paid performance (a three year CRO programme of A/B tests), Chicco for organic demand, brand and data (a GA4 migration and SEO strategy) and Università Telematica Pegaso for data and AI (a marketing mix model). No case carries a date.

Rag & Bone (a European launch), Emak (new sites) and Altra Running (Black Friday sales) have case studies the read left unassigned; Napapijri is a 2026-09 press item only; the rest are homepage logos with no described work, from Allianz to Vans, their needs inferred from the SEO and performance media it leads with. Shared clients: Allianz also sits with merkle and transmission, Calzedonia with promodo, Lavazza with the-social-shepherd, Salesforce with instrument and Stellantis with razorfish.

The observed mix leads with data and measurement (share 0.226), then brand and web build (0.194 each). The banks and fashion houses on this book are likely, with moderate confidence, to ask next for the audited AI visibility that KJ1 (The click is being replaced by the citation) describes.
house: Say and do: 1 of 4 tested lines is practised on its own house. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 1 AI topic URL. Paid Social is contradicted: no social ad pixel runs on its own site. Publishing cadence is contradicted: a blog exists but nothing in its sitemap was updated in 12 months; the record shows 241 sitemap URLs, 0 updated in 90 days and 0 in 365 days. Paid Search is unknown because the Transparency Center lookup was blocked. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: the Ad Library shows 7 ads, 6 company page ads and 1 thought leader ad, one line reads 'Digitalizzare le azioni di marketing significa garantire il futuro del tuo business'. The tag stack is GTM, the CMS Next.js; no social pixel, test tool or ABM stack was detected. It blocks no AI crawlers. The record holds no Meta or TikTok ad library reading.
market:
Horus reads Webranking at a tailwind index of 10.2, band Favored, 45th percentile, resilience 34.8. It is best placed for KJ1, the click being replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO at +2 and Paid Search at +1 against SEO at -1, and for KJ2, ads inside AI answers. It is most exposed to KJ5, the price of attention splitting in two, with Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV at -1 each. Best scenario fit is The Bazaar of Agents at 37/100. It is making P4; partial on P1, P6 and P7; absent on P2 (feeds and entities) and P8 (ads inside assistants); P5 unknown; P3 not applicable.

Monsoon reads 48.2, band Breeze, 22nd percentile: migration 50.7 against displacement 45.7. The verdict puts 51 of the index on the sold mix, SEO and web carrying the most movable hours; the shore split is 35% South and Southeast Asia, 40% Eastern Europe, 15% Africa and the Maghreb. No hub office is listed, the footprint is inferred; the record reads the Osservatori research line as an onshore delivery claim.
openings:
The strongest opening is the say and do gap on AI visibility. Webranking sells AI Search / GEO, yet publishes no llms.txt, shows 1 AI topic URL in a 241 URL sitemap and has no audited AI visibility product in the record: a rival that leads with a citation share number and a scorecard is likely, with moderate confidence, to win that conversation. The falsifier: an llms.txt on webranking.it and a published AI visibility tracking product would close this opening.

The second is content: nothing in its sitemap was updated in 12 months while SEO is its lead line at score 3, and a rival that puts the two facts side by side is very likely to land.

21 of its 30 clients are names only, and Allianz (also on merkle and transmission), Calzedonia (promodo), Lavazza (the-social-shepherd), Salesforce (instrument) and Stellantis (razorfish) shop across tracked agencies. The offer that undercuts it is transparent, outcome priced work, since the record lists no pricing model (P5 unknown), paired with the feeds, schema and entity line it does not show (P2 absent). A straight offshore rate undercut is unlikely to move this enterprise book at a Monsoon displacement of 45.7.
